title: What if Berkeley and Stanford switched campuses?
narrator: Deadpan documentary: calm and dry, treats the impossible premise like a serious report. The jokes land through understatement.
logline: Two rivals 31 miles apart trade homes overnight, and both find out the other side has problems too.

cues.onScreen: What if Berkeley and Stanford switched campuses?
cues.narration: What if Berkeley and Stanford swapped campuses?
cues.delivery: Straight question over the two towers crossing.

cues.onScreen: Berkeley: the Campanile, foggy hills, and big opinions.
cues.narration: Berkeley: a 307-foot Campanile, steep hills, strong opinions.
cues.delivery: Fond, a little wry on 'strong opinions'.

cues.onScreen: Stanford: Hoover Tower, palm trees, and golf carts.
cues.narration: Stanford: palm trees, golf carts, endless lawns.
cues.delivery: Same rhythm as the Berkeley line, mirrored.

cues.onScreen: One night, both campuses lift off and swap.
cues.narration: One night, they trade places. Nobody asked the students.

cues.onScreen: Only 31 miles apart, and still stuck in traffic.
cues.narration: Only 31 miles apart. Somehow, the moving trucks still hit traffic on 101.
cues.delivery: Weary local-news tone for the traffic.

cues.onScreen: Everyone wakes up on the wrong campus.
cues.narration: Everyone wakes up on the wrong campus. Breakfast is confusing.

cues.onScreen: Problem 1: Berkeley students discover free golf carts.
cues.narration: Berkeley finds 8,353 acres. Then finds the golf carts.

cues.onScreen: Problem 2: Stanford students try protesting. Politely.
cues.narration: Stanford tries protesting. The sign says: mild concerns. Turnout: three.
cues.delivery: Read the sign text very politely.

cues.onScreen: Problem 3: The Big Game is a home game for both.
cues.narration: The Big Game, running since 1892, now has two home teams.
cues.delivery: Puzzled, like a sports desk reading a rules memo.

cues.onScreen: By week two, the campuses start to blend.
cues.narration: Week two: Stanford discovers hills. Berkeley discovers parking.
Which campus would you wake up on?

notes: 31 miles is the fact pack's 50 km straight-line distance (v02.c.distance) in miles; it is allowed explicitly because the pack only stores km.
101 is the freeway name (US 101), not a statistic.

The fact pack for this video is still a draft (verified: false). Numbers spoken here match its values, but confirm them before recording: Sather Tower 307 ft (v02.f.sather_tower) and the Big Game since 1892 (v02.f.big_game). 8,353 acres is verified.
